name: Asia Connect
summary: Sydney dialup + permanent access ISP aimed at Asian business/private users; frameset splash abandoned after 2001, gone by ~2002.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 17 Apr 2001 (asiaconnect.com.au); Sydney ISP.

Frameset splash last changed 2001; thereafter an identical placeholder frameset was captured unchanged through 2006 (site abandoned, not maintained). Proposal/current agree on c. 2001-02 and the replayed captures support 'never a maintained retail site in the archive record' — domain now fails DNS. homepage an abandoned empty 'AsiaConnect.com.au' splash from first capture May 2001 through Aug 2007.

refs.label: Even the first capture (16 May 2001) is a content-free splash page
Unchanged splash through Aug 2007 confirms an abandoned rather than operating ISP site from ~2001-02
ABR: ASIA CONNECT PTY LTD ACN 678 861 839 (ABN active from 5 Jul 2024, NSW 2137 — a later same-name company, not the 2001 ISP)
